full_candidate_collection.role: Complete docking-score-selected collection retained for traceability and further investigation

target_pose_eligible.role: Candidates eligible for Pareto-front analysis after target-pose convergence

primary_computational_shortlist.role: Primary prioritized deliverable for further validation; a subset of the 904-candidate collection
primary_computational_shortlist.highlight: Lavender row and Final Pareto shortlist badge

pareto_method.diversity_metric: ECFP4 radius=2, 2048 bits; reported, not hard-filtered
pareto_method.druglike: strict improvement in QED, SA, or distance to cLogP [1,5]

evidence_tiers.A_both_stable: target and off-target pose convergence pass
evidence_tiers.F_target_unstable: target convergence fails; excluded from Pareto fronts

pareto_method.grouping: within docking task and pose-evidence tier
pareto_method.safety: maximum of nine declared liability probabilities <= matched seed maximum
pareto_method.shortlist_rule: seed-relative eligible and on at least two of three domain fronts

relation_to_mmgbsa: Frozen Pareto membership is independent of the later MM-GBSA improvement flag. The 438-member shortlist is not the set of 447 candidates with delta < 0.
interpretation: Neither collection is experimentally validated for activity or receptor selectivity.
